pages.name: All designs
pages.summary: Compendium of shipped/approved OA screens 2024-25: base OA w/ and w/o cluster name, all service variants (GTA, Auto Plus, Share, Bike, ORB, Auto boost), card DIMENSIONS redlines, c2c/b2b+food delivery, Auto Pet, NCR, Multistop, Scooty, Cab XL, Draw-over single/multi order rules, ORB with 2 orders, Rejection icon (2 Jul '25), Double acceptance (normal/draw-over/ORB), Cab Sedan AC/Eco AC (Section 1), Student Auto, Customer Tips. Also a 32-row text spec 'Detailed Order Accept Screen Combinations' and 'SYSTEM OF OA DESIGN' board (5346:14319).
pages.notes: Treated as tier A on orchestrator advice (name has no tier-A keyword). Mix of current and older (Sep-Dec '24) designs; old full-screen 360x637 frames use the pre-revamp card. Double acceptance, Rejection icon, Customer Tips, Student Auto, Cab Sedan AC are current.

pages.name: E-Rick OA
pages.summary: E-Rickshaw / Seat Share OA cards (272x382). Section 1 'Version 1' (white header) vs 'Version 2' (teal gradient header) + exportable E-Rick seat-share icon; Section 2 ~20 iterations incl. food delivery and person/group icons; Section 3 'Explorations': 2 Rejected (people icons) + 1 Finalised (e-rick vehicle icon with 'Seat Share' label pill).
pages.notes: Finalised = 9382:23398 (vehicle icon + label pill, teal theme). Uses Runway OA Cards (R) instance 9379:18329.

pages.name: Final - Voice OA
pages.summary: Final Voice-based OA: OA screen with VO toggle (ON/OFF) in header, voice highlights the field being read (card border green, then address highlight, then fare highlight). Edge cases: ORB, Drawover, Double acceptance, Exclusive ping. Intercity OA highlighting order. Icon change for VO toggle (1 Jul '25). 3 'On-Duty OA' frames (8023:*) using local O1/O2/O3 side-bar tabs.
pages.notes: Prototype links on page. Uses local VO Toggle (not Runway Toggle) and local F1 Drop-Fare cards built from remote Spacer comps — not Runway Card.

oaFramework.source: 8890:7129 (OA framework page, dated 15 May '26); draft at 8730:* on Kitchen - OA Framework - June '25
principles: Limited attention: an OA card shows max 2 signals (sub-service + one context, e.g. CabXL_Company, Auto_Premium, Sedan_Intercity). Not allowed: CabXL_Company_Premium, CabXL_Premium_Intercity.

Prioritisation: only the highest-priority signal is emphasised. Preference themes > Contextual themes > Base service. Preferences: GTA > SIA. Exception: Corporate/Company can override everything (exceptions must be agreed).
Separation: Base service = minimum & most common; Sub-service = what the job is; Contextual = why it matters; Preference = what captain wants.
No free visual weight: no icon/theme unless qualified through the framework; every new order/service must fit one bucket.

buckets.name: Sub-Service
buckets.differentiation: service icon only (top-right 72x82 icon + chip icon)

buckets.name: Contextual Orders
buckets.frequency: less frequent, highly desirable, very short acceptance time

byService.Parcel/Food/Grocery: not a separate service: sub-services of Bike (and Auto Parcel); parcel 'Icon + Theme' experiment (June '26) would conflict with 'sub-service creating theme' rule
byService.Intercity: contextual bucket (theme: sky/cloud gradient header + destination city + distance/duration); local Service Chip has Base Service=Intercity (Eco/Pre/XL Intercity) - conflicts with framework
byService.Multistop: not in framework (Jan '25 design uses '2 Stops' pill on route)

nonAllowed: Feature requesting custom UI outside framework
oaFramework.exceptions: Goal is not to prevent exceptions but to control, contain and expire them.

observedThemes.Base: white card, no icon (Bike Taxi 8289:13187, Auto 8023:84682)
observedThemes.Sub-service: white card + 72x82 top-right raster icon; chip icon tinted per sub-service (Scooty scooter, Grocery bag, Parcel bag, Food burger, Pet dog, XL black badge, AC blue badge, NCR, Zepto, Student auto, E-rick)
observedThemes.Premium/Priority (contextual): near-black header, gold chip text + gold fare, ₹/km EPKM, 3D gold star; cream body #fff2de (8289:10483, 8267:9358)
observedThemes.Company (contextual): blue header + businessman illustration, chip 'XL - Company' (7229:2421)
observedThemes.Intercity (contextual): sky/cloud gradient header, destination 'Varkala, Kerala' + '636 KM (6 Hrs 20min)' (6656:64164 variant 4, 5602:68807)
observedThemes.GTA (preference): pink header + pink-tinted body, heart map-pin icon, chip 'Bike -GTA'/'Go To Area' (8289:11283, 7474:5481); also GTA Tag row '15Km away from your Go To' (pink outline) on non-GTA themes
observedThemes.Seat Share/E-Rick: teal gradient header + e-rick icon with label pill (9382:23398)
observedThemes.Tips: green 'Customer added ₹20 extra' bar above CTAs (not a theme)

oaFramework.earlierSpec: 407:1548 text 'Detailed Order Accept Screen Combinations' (2024): 5 modifiers (New service, New rate card, Preference order, Extra earning, Tip) and all 32 combinations — superseded by the 2-signal rule of the 2026 framework.

runwayComparison: Card anatomy matches Runway .Base OA (Header > Location Details > Tips card/Extra card > CTAs > hidden Contextual Order Icon); widths drift: Runway 272, local OA set 264, older cards 268/260.

Runway OA Cards is split by vehicle (Service=Bike/Auto/Cab OA, with 9-12 'Type' variants each); the framework and the local OA set (6656:64164) split by bucket (Type=Base Service | Sub Service | Contextual orders | Intercity) with booleans Extra Card/Gems/Tips/Payment Method. Runway has no theme/contextual variant (no header theme fill, no Company/Priority/Premium/GTA-theme), only GTA Tag row + 'Show Cab Extra Icon'.

Runway .Service Chips (18 variants, single Sub-Service prop, labels 'Cab Eco', 'Auto Share') vs local Service Chip (6640:63378, Base Service x Sub Service, 16v incl. Intercity Eco/Pre/XL, Cab AC/Non-AC; no Corporate/Company, no Cab Share). Labels differ: 'Cab Non-AC' vs Runway 'Cab Economy'. Black chip (Scooty, Auto Plus) still used for premium sub-services even though framework says sub-services get icon only.
Runway has no Service Icons set for the 72x82 OA icon with label pill; local Service Icons (6656:63909, Type New/Old x Service) and Runway assets/icons/service PNGs overlap.

Side-bar tabs O1/O2/O3 are local; Dev Ticket Aug '25 removes empty order placeholders (Runway HomeOfOrders still has 'Empty Order Bar'). No empty/off-duty state appears in this file.
